segments.text: A super positive and high tension demon youth who appears in the human world.
He should be an influential person, but that unfortunate personality ruins everything.
Hio's older sister. She has known Yuuto and his family since childhood.
Looks-like-an-extrovert asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: Got tired of living.
Lingering attachment to this world: Wants to have a real girlfriend.

A high-school senior and former captain of the basketball team. A friendly, sociable, and cheerful playboy with an uninhibited personality that might seem unfit for reaching his goal of ‘getting a true girlfriend’. He lives alone with his foster father.

He tends to be goofy and amiable while joking around, but in reality he’s a very sceptical person. Incredibly sharp and observant with a deep sense of morality and human sensitivity. A man made up of contradictions as he’s also rational and cold-hearted, which makes him go from being open and considerate to ice-cold in an instant.

He’s brimming with curiosity and repeatedly gets invested in a wide range of things, but loses interest in them very fast. Those around him look at him with either admiration or disgust. 70% of the time it’s the former. He often contradicts himself during conversations as his opinions change quite frequently. Girls and boys of all ages tend to ask him for advice a lot, so he probably knows a considerable amount of other people’s secrets.
Adapted from the official website and Twitter.

One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. She is a detective in the Heinous Crimes Unit. Personality-wise, she is a rather average young woman who prefers to stay on the good side of her superiors.
She is killed by a postman while investigating the victim's room having barely started working on the case.
Haruma's quiet and shy twin sister.

Sophia's mother. Unlike Sophia, she is a pure-blood vampire. She raised Sophia to not be ashamed of the aristocrats of the vampire world. Like her daughter, she is not active during the daytime and prefers coming out at night. She has a mild-mannered personality, but she also has a strict side that comes with being part of a race that rules at the top echelons of demon-kind (she also shows a silly side when with Sophia). Vampire maids are always serving at her side.
The landlady of Kazahana Sou, who is a widow and Fuuka's mother.
She is a SM enthusiast with a masochistic taste, who went as far as creating a dedicated room in the attic of her apartment.
Translated from Getchu and Wikipedia.

Saya Friday is a young noble lady from Leazas, belonging to the Friday family and also Patty the Summer's sister. Along with other Leazas nobles, she has an intense dislike over the queen Lia Parapara Leazas, and directly acted against her even before she was crowned as the queen.
